title: Note on Emerging Science: Sea 'Lavender' Stores Carbon
desc: Sea ‘lavender,’ a purple flowering plant also known as statice that grows abundantly in salt marshes and coasts around the world, appears to be excellent at removing planet-warming carbon from the atmosphere and storing it in soils. Living on Earth’s Julia Vaz reports on this recent research.

title: Saskatchewan Government recognizes MS Awareness Month
desc: As May comes to a close, the Saskatchewan Government is marking Multiple Sclerosis (MS) Awareness Month by recognizing ongoing efforts to strengthen access to MS care across the province. MS Awareness Month focuses on building greater public awareness and understanding of the disease, while acknowledging the experiences of people living with MS, as well as their families and caregivers. The clinic delivers specialized treatment and long-term disease management through a team that includes MS-trained neurologists, registered nurses, and other interdisciplinary health professionals.
